JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange Crew
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Win the Coral-Eye, Sea Ruby, Spike Shell and Jade Star Badges from Cissy, Danny, Rudy and Luana.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beat Drake's full six-Pokemon team at Pummelo Stadium to win the Winner's Trophy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Crystal Onix
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mateo on Sunburst Island says a glass-clear Onix lives in the Crystal Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.desc: Welcome to the Orange Islands! Professor Ivy's aides will take you to her. She's out on the beach on the west of the island.
Meet Professor Ivy in her lab on the west side of Valencia Island. She has a partner Pokémon for you.
Professor Ivy and Brock are watching the wild Vileplume in Valencia Park. Join them there.
Professor Ivy and her Raticate were caught by the Stun Spore. See how they are at the Pokémon Center.
The way to the next island is over the sea. Ask at the airport, south of Valencia Island: a blimp flies right over Tangelo Island.
You landed in Pokémon Park on Tangelo Island. Head west through the park to the town.
Somebody is shouting at the north end of Tangelo Island, by the water. Go and see what's going on!
The young Lapras is badly hurt. Go to Tangelo's Pokémon Center and see how it is.
Lapras is resting in the pool behind the Pokémon Center. Go and see it.
Lapras is travelling with you now. Let Misty and Tracey know: they're in the Pokémon Center.
With Lapras you can Surf! Mikan Island, home of the first Orange Crew Gym, is north of Tangelo across Route 50.
Mikan Island's Gym Leader, Cissy, is the first of the Orange Crew. Pass her two tests, then beat her in battle for the Coral-Eye Badge!
Surf east along Route 53 to Mandarin Island North, a busy city.
Officer Jenny is looking into strange goings-on in Mandarin Island North. She's at the south-west of the city.
Pokémon on Mandarin are disobeying their trainers. That old power plant with the giant antenna, north of the city, looks suspicious...
Mandarin's Pokémon are calm again. A climber in the house just south of the Rocket Hideout wants to thank you; then Surf south along Route 54 to Sunburst Island, the island of glass.
Tracey has heard of a mysterious Pokémon in Sunburst Island's Crystal Cave. Go and see! (He's waiting near the east beach.)
Surf south from Sunburst along Route 55, then east to Pinkan Island, where the Pokémon are said to be pink.
Tracey is sketching a pink Rhyhorn on Pinkan Island, west of the Preserve's hut. Go and see him.
Poachers are about on Pinkan Island, and the Pokémon are angry. Head east across the island.
{rival_name} says the next Gym is on Navel Island, far to the east. Surf east from Pinkan along Route 56 toward Fukuhara Island.
Navel Island's Gym is still far to the east. Cross Fukuhara Island and Surf Route 57 north to Kinnow Island.
Nurse Joy is digging for fossils on Fukuhara Island. Help her: take her Pickaxe into the Bay Cave and break its rocks.
Kinnow is a busy port. Navel Island's Gym lies east: Surf Route 58 from Kinnow's north shore.
Navel Island has no Gym building: Danny waits at the top of Navel Mountain. Climb its rock faces with the Climb Kit and battle him for the Sea Ruby Badge!
Two badges! Surf south from Navel along Route 59, past the Seven Grapefruit Islands, to Moro Island and its famous Museum.
Something is eating the Grapefruit Islands' crop. Find Ruby, the owner, on Grapefruit Island One and help her.
The Moro Island Museum's researcher wants to bring Pokémon back from fossils. Take your fossil to the Museum's upper floor.
Surf west from Moro along Route 60 to Golden Island, then east along Route 61 to Murcott Island, the home of Bug Pokémon.
Tracey found an injured Scyther in Murcott Meadows. See what becomes of it.
Surf south from Murcott along Route 62, past the island of Farfetch'd, to Mandarin Island South, the biggest of the Orange Islands.
Leave Mandarin Island South by the north road. Your rival {rival_name} is touring the Orange Islands too...
{rival_name} says Rudy's Gym is on Trovita Island. Leave Mandarin Island South by Route 63, north toward Yambera.
Team Rocket blasted off again. Carry on north up Route 63 to the quiet village of Yambera.
Head west from Yambera along Route 64, across the Mandarin Desert. Something odd is going on out there...
Ethan's Magneton is safe. Head south from Desert Town, out of the desert, to the big city of Trovitopolis.
Ralph and Emily of Yambera keep losing their Nidoran. Look around the village for the pair.
Rudy's Gym is on Trovita Island. Leave Trovitopolis by Route 65, west along the beach, then cross the sea to Trovita.
Rudy leads the Trovita Island Gym. Go in and challenge him for the Spike Shell Badge... he may have a better place in mind.
You beat Rudy! Ride the balloon back down with him, then find the islander who said a Gym winner deserves something handy.
A policeman guards Trovitopolis's sewers on the Mayor's orders. Visit the Mayor's office, then see what's down there.
Misty and Tracey went north. Take Route 66 north from Trovita, then east into Route 56: the Whirlpuller will get you through the whirlpools round Fairchild Island's south beach.
Pokémon grow big and strong on Fairchild Island. Follow the path through the island towards its north beach.
Team Rocket ran off in a panic. Leave Fairchild by its north path to the beach, then surf north onto Route 67.
Somebody on Route 67 says a nest of very strong Pidgeot is hidden on an island nearby. Look around Fairchild Island.
Team Rocket blasted off again. Surf on north up Route 67, then east along Route 68 and north to Ascorbia Island.
A trainer called Tad is training his Poliwrath on a beach on Route 68, by Cleopatra Island. He wants a match.
Team Rocket carried off Ascorbia's firefighting Team Wartortle in their balloon. Follow Captain Aidan into Ascorbia Forest.
Team Wartortle are safe. Take the stairs down to Ascorbia's north-west beach and Surf west along Route 69 to Kumquat Island, home of the fourth Gym.
Captain Aidan is back at Ascorbia's fire station. He wanted to thank you properly.
Route 67's west side runs to Shamouti Island, where they're getting ready for the Legend Festival.
Kumquat's Gym is in the big hotel, and its Leader is Luana. Misty and Tracey are on the beach: say hello first.
Four Orange Crew badges! The Orange League waits on Pummelo Island. Surf west from Kumquat along Route 70, then south down Routes 71 and 72.
A door in the cliffs on Route 69 leads up on to Butwal Island, home of a trainer who says he's the best with Grass-types.
A Pokémon Watcher on Route 71 studies the Magikarp that come home to Rind Island once a year.
Misty and Tracey are camping in a cabin on Salveyo Island, off Route 72. Something seems wrong.
Champion Drake waits on Pummelo Island. Find him at the Palace of Victory at the top of the island, then meet him in Pummelo Stadium.
Hamlin Island stands empty, its Pokémon Center shut. Something keeps exploding in the streets...
You're the Orange League Champion! The Legend Festival is starting on Shamouti Island. Go and see what all the fuss is about.
The Chosen One must bring the spheres of the three islands to Shamouti's shrine. Melody says to start on Fire Island: its cave is on Shamouti's east side.
You and Melody were pulled up into a giant flying ship, along with Zapdos. Who would do such a thing?
The flying palace crashed on Lightning Island. Find its sphere at the top of the island, quickly: the three birds are fighting.
A strange force carried you to Shamouti's shrine. Set the spheres on the altar.
One sphere short! Lugia says only the Chosen One can wake the Ice Sphere. Ice Island's cave is on Shamouti's south shore.
With the world in harmony again, Moltres, Zapdos and Articuno have gone home to their islands.
Tracey is helping Professor Ivy on Valencia now. He says a new island has been found somewhere in the Orange Islands.
The Pokémon Showboat is docked at Kinnow Island. With a Showboat Pass you can go aboard and see its show.
An old man in a house on Mikan Island has a Pokemon that fights with its fists. He's looking for a trainer to take it along.
Someone in Trovitopolis once won a very unusual Pokemon. He'd like to give it a new home, far from where it came from.
Something is trapped inside the amber from Fukuhara's dig. The researcher at Moro's museum might be able to bring it back.
People all over the Orange Islands are hoping to swap one Pokemon for another. Bring them what they ask for and see what they give you back.

lines: Professor Ivy: Welcome to my lab! It's much nicer to talk in here than out on the sand.
Professor Ivy: I study how the Pokémon of these islands differ from the same kinds elsewhere. New colours, new sizes...
Professor Ivy: That odd ball on the table? We call it the GS Ball: a G and an S are carved on it. Nobody can open it, so Professor Oak is looking into it.
Professor Ivy: Now, the reason you're here. Every trainer needs a partner. Pick one of my Pokémon to travel with!
Professor Ivy: Brock and I are going to Valencia Park to watch the wild Vileplume. Join us there!

done: Professor Ivy: See you in Valencia Park!

lines: Professor Ivy: Drop in whenever you like. And if Professor Oak learns anything about the GS Ball, tell me!
Brock: I'm Brock! I'm staying on Valencia to help Professor Ivy with her research.
Brock: Somebody has to cook and clean around here. This lab feels just like home!
Brock: Good luck out there. Friends to the end!
Fisherman: Some water Pokémon stay deep down, and only a rod brings them up.
Fisherman: I'm feeling generous. Take one of my old rods and try your luck!
done: Fisherman: Cast that rod into any water you find. How are they biting?

fail: Clerk: Welcome to Rocket Blimps! This blimp flies to Goldenrod City in Johto.
Clerk: Not travelling today? Then please step aside for the passengers.
lines: Clerk: Welcome to Rocket Blimps! The blimp to Kanto is grounded for repairs, I'm afraid.
Clerk: Bored of Valencia already? Here's a secret: this blimp to Johto flies right over Tangelo Island.
Clerk: Strap on a parachute and you can jump out over Tangelo. Just don't tell my bosses!
You climb aboard. The blimp lifts off... and over Tangelo Island, you jump!
done: Clerk: My bosses found out about that jump. No more parachutes, sorry!
Clerk: You'll have to find another way to Tangelo Island.

fail: Clerk: Welcome to Rocket Blimps! The blimp to Kanto is under repair, I'm afraid.
Clerk: It'll take a while. Why not see the islands in the meantime?
lines: Clerk: The blimp to Kanto is fixed at last! All aboard for Vermilion City.
The Rocket Blimp floats north over the sea to Kanto...
Tracey: Hi! Surprised to see me here? I'm helping Professor Ivy with her research now. I was so nervous at first!
Tracey: Filling your Pokédex is hard work, but don't give up. The more Pokémon you catch, the more we learn!
Tracey: Wow, you've caught so many Pokémon! Then it's time I told you: a new island has been found in the Orange Islands.
Tracey: Very strong Pokémon live there, so no one has explored it properly. Maybe you can! Take this.
You got a MysticTicket! Tracey: With it you can take the ferry to New Island from Hamlin Harbor.

done: Tracey: Everyone has a different path. You catch and train Pokémon; I watch and study them. Follow your passion!

lines: A Revival Herb, growing by the path.
Tracey: I'm Tracey, a Pokémon Watcher. Lapras is resting in the pool behind the Center.
Tracey: You took Lapras along? So it trusts you now. That's great!
Tracey: Travelling with a kind trainer is just what it needs. Lapras can carry you over the sea, too.
Misty: Take good care of it! We'll be travelling too. See you around the islands!

done: Tracey: See you around the islands!

lines: Misty: I hope Lapras is feeling better. It went through so much.

fail: Lapras looks at you warily from the pool.
lines: Lapras trusts you now. It looks like it wants to come with you!
You got Lapras! It can carry you across the sea: you can Surf now.

boss.name: Ho-Oh
lines: A rainbow lights the sky over the water... Ho-Oh lands before you!
An Ether, half hidden in the grass.
Collector: Look what I found: some kind of parachute! It's yours? Oh, can I keep it for my collection?
Collector: Thanks! Here, have something from my collection in return.
done: Collector: I love poking around the park for odd things.

lines: Boy: You think you can beat Cissy? No way! My big sister never loses!
Boy: You actually beat my sister?! ...Fine. I guess you earned it.

intro: Cissy: I'm Cissy of the Orange Crew. You passed my tests. Now, Seadra and Blastoise, let's go!
player_won: Cissy: Outstanding! The Coral-Eye Badge is yours.
Cissy: Take this TM too: Water Pulse. Teach it to a Pokémon of the sea!
player_lost: Cissy: Better work on that aim. Come back any time!

lines: Marissa: Nobody believes me, but my brother Mateo is one of the best glassblowers around.
Marissa: If only he could find his inspiration again...
Marissa: I can't thank you enough for helping Mateo!
Mateo: Business is booming since I saw the Crystal Onix. Thanks again!
Man: ...You look like a decent trainer. Maybe you can use this.
done: Man: Brick Break smashes through Reflect and Light Screen.

lines: A Hard Stone, glinting by the water.
A TM, wedged between the crystals: Dig.
Grunt: Walk on, kid. Nothing to see in this old power plant. Didn't you read the sign?
Grunt: Disobedient Pokémon? Never heard of them. ...You want to look for yourself? Then I can't let you!
Officer Jenny: Pokémon all over the island are disobeying their trainers. We think a Psychic Pokémon is behind it.
Officer Jenny: If you find anything, tell me. And keep your Pokémon in their Poké Balls!
Climber: I just got home, and some guy in a black suit was packing up to leave. He'd been living here for weeks!
Climber: Team Rocket? And you drove them out? Then thank you! Here, take this. I made it myself.
done: Climber: That Climb Kit gets you up any rocky wall. I love climbing mountains all over the world!

lines: Officer Jenny: You stopped Team Rocket's antenna! The Pokémon are back to normal. Thank you!
A Rare Candy, left in a storeroom.
Zinc, in a dusty crate.
Calcium, on a shelf.
Carbos, by the machines.
The Lift Key! Now the lift will work.
A Protein, behind the boxes.
Iron, in a corner.
An HP Up, in the storage room.
Jessie: Stop right there, twerp! James: You've no business in our hideout!
done: Meowth: Butch and Cassidy are down on B1F... Oops! Did I say that out loud?

lines: Butch: The Boss put us in charge here! Our Drowzee's waves go out through that antenna on the roof...
Cassidy: A few more weeks and every Pokémon on the island will obey us! ...Hey, who are you?!
Cassidy: You beat Butch? Then try me!

done: Cassidy: This isn't over!

lines: A Rare Candy, under a Pinkan Berry bush.
A TM in the grass: Bulk Up.
{rival_name}: Hey! Running away from me? Surprised to see me here?
{rival_name}: After the Indigo League I came here on holiday. Then I found a Gym on Mikan Island. Let's see how you've been doing!
{rival_name}: So you're taking on the Orange League? The next Gym is on Navel Island, the one with the big snowy mountain, east of here.
{rival_name}: This might help you on the way. Smell you later!

done: {rival_name}: Smell you later!

lines: Fisherman: I see a spark in your eyes! Here, show it off with this.
Fisherman: Wherever there's water, the Good Rod can hook Pokémon.
done: Fisherman: Any luck fishing around the Orange Islands?

lines: Man: People and Pokémon run off when they see my Growlithe. It knows Roar, you see. Here!
done: Man: Roar ends a wild battle, or makes your foe switch Pokémon.

lines: Guest: It's great to stay with an old friend instead of in my Showboat cabin.
Guest: You want to board the Showboat? I don't need my pass while I'm here. Take it!
done: Guest: That pass gets you aboard the Showboat as often as you like.

lines: Deckhand: Welcome to the Pokémon Showboat! Your pass, please... Thank you. Go right on board!
fail: Deckhand: Welcome to the Pokémon Showboat! You'll need a Showboat Pass to come aboard.

lines: An Iron, on the little island.
Misty: Great battle, Marina! ...Wait, my Psyduck evolved? No: that Golduck was wild all along!
Misty: I could use something to take my mind off it. Let's battle!
done: Misty: You've got stronger out here. I'm off to rest on Navel Island; they say one of the Orange Crew is there.

lines: Marina: I love how quiet this little island is. Fancy a battle?
done: Marina: Good battle! Good luck in the Orange Islands.

fail: Ruby: Please stop that Snorlax before it eats every grapefruit on the islands!
lines: Ruby: Thank you! That Snorlax would have eaten every last grapefruit. Please take this as thanks.
Ruby: A Pokémon holding a Silk Scarf hits harder with Normal-type moves.
done: Ruby: The grapefruit trees are doing wonderfully, thanks to you!

lines: Snorlax is munching its way through a pile of grapefruits...
Snorlax is still munching grapefruits...
It doesn't even look up. It finishes the tree, then lumbers off toward Grapefruit Island Three!
Whoa! What a huge Magikarp!
Nurse Joy: My old friend Magikarp is low on Calcium. Here you go... Feeling better already!
...Magikarp is evolving! Nurse Joy: After all these years, a strong Gyarados! Off you go!
Nurse Joy: You really care about Pokémon, I can tell. I'm off to help a Shellder underwater. Come too, with this!
done: Nurse Joy is somewhere under the sea now.

lines: Nurse Joy is down here with a Shellder, in her own diving gear! ... ...
She points up to the surface: she's heading back. Then she waves at the reef around you. Maybe you should look around.
Nurse Joy swims off towards the light.
A Mystic Water, among the seaweed.

fail: Trader: Hello! Do you have a Jynx? I'd trade you my Magmar for one.
lines: Trader: A Jynx! Will you trade it for my Magmar? Thanks!
Trader: That Magmar I traded you... has it grown stronger?

player_won: Danny: Well done! You've proven you're worthy of the Sea Ruby Badge.
Danny: The badge makes your Pokémon a little faster. And take this TM: Ice Beam. It suits an Ice-type Pokémon!
player_lost: Danny: Good climb, good battle. Come back up when you're ready!
intro: Danny: You climbed Navel Mountain. Now let's battle!

lines: Danny: Clean air, a great view... the perfect place for a Pokémon battle!
Danny: You climbed Navel Mountain on your own, so you're a worthy challenger. I used to race challengers down on ice sleds, but the snow line moves too much with the seasons.
Danny: So it's a plain battle. Let's go!

player_won: Danny: Well done! You've proven you're worthy of the Sea Ruby Badge.
Danny: The badge makes your Pokémon a little faster. And take this TM: Ice Beam. It suits an Ice-type Pokémon!
player_lost: Danny: Good climb, good battle. Come back up when you're ready!

done: Danny: Isn't Navel Mountain beautiful? Come back for some fresh air any time!

lines: A Carbos, left by a climber.
A piece of ice that never melts: NeverMeltIce!
A TM in the snow: Hail.

fail: Attendant: Welcome to the Navel Mountain cable car!
Attendant: Gym challengers must reach the top on foot, though. Good luck with the climb!
lines: Attendant: The cable car is ready to take you to the top of the mountain. Step this way!
The cable car glides up the mountainside...

fail: Attendant: Welcome to the Navel Mountain cable car!
Attendant: Shouldn't you beat Danny before you ride down?
lines: Attendant: The cable car is ready to take you to the foot of the mountain. Step this way!
The cable car glides down the mountainside...
A PP Up, by the path.
Sailor: Nothing beats the feeling of being out on the open sea! You came here on Lapras's back?
Sailor: A trainer who loves the sea should have this. Take it!
done: Sailor: That TM holds Hydro Pump, a mighty blast of water. A Water-type Pokémon will put it to good use!

lines: Move Deleter: Hm? Oh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter. I used to make Pokémon forget moves.
Move Deleter: These days your Pokémon remember everything they've learned, so there's little for me to do!
Researcher: Is that a Helix Fossil? It's a fossil of Omanyte, a Pokémon from long ago!
Researcher: My new experiment might bring it back to life. Let's try!
...The machine whirs and hums...
Researcher: It worked! Here's Omanyte. Take good care of it!
Researcher: Is that a Dome Fossil? It's a fossil of Kabuto, a Pokémon from long ago!
Researcher: My new experiment might bring it back to life. Let's try!
...The machine whirs and hums...
Researcher: It worked! Here's Kabuto. Take good care of it!
Researcher: Is that a piece of Old Amber? It's a fossil of Aerodactyl, a Pokémon from long ago!
Researcher: My new experiment might bring it back to life. Let's try!
...The machine whirs and hums...
Researcher: It worked! Here's Aerodactyl. Take good care of it!

done: Researcher: I'm working on a way to bring Pokémon back from fossils. Bring me any fossil and I'll try it!

lines: A Spell Tag, in the dark of the undersea cave.
Elder: Welcome, humble visitor! We see few travellers on Golden Island. For your interest in our people, take this!
Elder: An Amulet Coin. Hold it on a Pokémon and you'll earn more money from trainer battles.
done: Elder: When the Meowth of Bounty comes, our people will be rich!

lines: Tracey: Hi! Scyther's already a little better, but it needs more rest.
Nurse Joy: Trainer! Come quickly!
Nurse Joy: Scyther just flew out through the window! It went straight back to Murcott Meadows!
Tracey: I'll go after it right away!
Man: I know just what a trainer like you needs: something to fight all the bugs on this island. Take this!
Man: That TM holds Aerial Ace, a Flying-type move that never misses!
done: Man: Has Aerial Ace helped against the bugs yet?

lines: Swimmer: This island's calm always puts me in a good mood. And in a good mood, I get generous!
Swimmer: Want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move? Just look around you: Waterfall!
Super Nerd: You're a trainer, right? I once won a Pokémon made of computer code. Would you look after it?
Super Nerd: I used to gamble a lot in Celadon City. Letting go of things from back then helps me stay on track.
done: Super Nerd: Porygon deserves a good trainer. Take care of it!

lines: Super Nerd: The Orange League Champion! Then you should have this. I won it with Porygon, back in my Celadon days.
Super Nerd: Let Porygon hold it, and it becomes Porygon2 - an upgrade!
done: Super Nerd: Porygon2 was made for space travel, they say. I hope yours goes far!
Super Nerd: Porygon deserves a good trainer. Take care of it!

lines: Mayor: Welcome to Trovitopolis! I'm the Mayor of this fine city. The election is coming up, so my campaign symbol is all over town!
Mayor: We leave nothing to chance. Remember to vote for me!
done: Mayor: Enjoy your stay in Trovitopolis. And don't forget to vote for me!

lines: Mayor: I didn't MEAN to leave my Bulbasaur in the sewers! I hope this little matter won't change your vote...
Secretary: I'm the Mayor's secretary. It looks like we'll win the election easily.
Secretary: After what happened, winning the election will be hard...
Psychic: I sensed a trainer would visit us today. Please, take this.
done: Psychic: Calm Mind raises both Sp. Atk and Sp. Def. A very useful Psychic move.

lines: Psychic: I sense you're a trainer... but do you have psychic powers too? Let's test you.
Psychic: I've hidden a coin in one hand. Which one?
again: Psychic: Correct! Again. Which hand is it in now?
win: Psychic: Splendid! Three times in a row! Psychic power or pure luck, you've earned this.
fail_guess: Psychic: No, wrong hand. Try again any time.
done: Psychic: A TwistedSpoon powers up Psychic-type moves when a Pokémon holds it.

lines: Girl: I wanted to see the sewers, but the policeman wouldn't let me by.
Girl: I love it when my parents take me to the Dept. Store!
Girl: I love it when my parents take me to the Dept. Store!
Man: The Mayor seems like a sensible man. I think I'll vote for him.
Man: I don't trust the Mayor any more. I hope someone else wins the election.
Officer Jenny: The Mayor won't let anyone near the sewers just now. People say a strange creature lives down there.
Officer Jenny: With the election coming, he isn't taking any chances.
Officer Jenny: Thank you for showing Trovitopolis who the Mayor really is. On behalf of the city, take this!
Officer Jenny: TM Solar Beam. It would suit a Pokémon like Bulbasaur.
done: Officer Jenny: A Mayor needs a good name. After this, I doubt he'll be re-elected.

lines: Policeman: Nobody goes past here. The Mayor has me guard the sewers day and night during the election.
Zzz... Zzz... He's dozing on the job!
Policeman: Who'd have thought the Mayor abandoned his Bulbasaur as a boy? He won't be re-elected now.
A TM in the trees: Protect.
Rudy: Welcome to the Trovita Island Gym! I'm Rudy, the Gym Leader. Taking on the Orange League, are you?
Rudy: A brave choice! But I know a much better spot for a battle than in here...
Rudy: Where? Only one way to find out. See you outside!
Rudy: Hello again! That Misty is really something special... Do you know if she's seeing anyone?
Mahri: Hi, Gym challenger! I'm Mahri, Rudy's little sister. He's training somewhere in the Gym.
Mahri: Wow, you beat Rudy! You must be a really good trainer!
Rudy: These cliffs rose up long ago, along with the island. I love battling up here.
Rudy: Enough talk! To earn the Spike Shell Badge, you'll have to beat me!

player_won: Rudy: What a battle! You've earned the Spike Shell Badge.
Rudy: The badge makes your Pokémon a little tougher. And take this: TM Psychic. A Psychic-type will love it!
player_lost: Rudy: Good try! Come and see me in the Gym when you're ready.

lines: Rudy: I think we've spent long enough up here. Back to the Gym!
Misty: Thanks, Rudy! It was great to watch. Tracey: One of the best battles I've ever seen!
The balloon floats gently back down...
Misty: We're heading north now. Tracey: The fourth Gym should be somewhere up there. See you!
Rudy: Good luck on your journey! You're always welcome at the Trovita Gym.

done: Rudy: What a view!

lines: Woman: Trovita has a lovely Gym building, doesn't it? A Gym battle in there must feel special.
Woman: A battle in the Gym is nice. But a battle on top of a high cliff must be even better!
Man: Have you battled Rudy, our Gym Leader? He's one of the strongest trainers I know.
Man: Anyone who can beat him deserves something handy...
Man: You did a great job beating Rudy. That Spike Shell Badge looks good on you.
Man: Whoa! Is that the Spike Shell Badge? You beat Rudy! Then you deserve this!
Man: With the Whirlpuller you can cross whirlpools. You'll need it to travel to the north of the Orange Islands.
Fisherman: ...You're a trainer, aren't you? Say no more. You need this!
Fisherman: The Super Rod is the best there is. The better the rod, the deeper you fish, and the stronger the Pokémon.
done: Fisherman: The deeper you fish, the stronger the Pokémon you'll find.

lines: Move Tutor: I'm the Move Tutor. I know every move a Pokémon learns as it grows up.
Move Tutor: I used to remind Pokémon of moves they'd forgotten, for a Heart Scale. These days Pokémon don't forget a thing!

player_won: Rudy: What a battle! You've earned the Spike Shell Badge.
Rudy: The badge makes your Pokémon a little tougher. And take this: TM Psychic. A Psychic-type will love it!
player_lost: Rudy: Good try! Come and see me in the Gym when you're ready.
intro: Rudy: Up here on the cliff... the perfect place for a battle. Let's go!

lines: An HP Up, among the flowers.
A TM by the pond: Hidden Power.
A TM at the island's top: Skill Swap.
A Heal Powder, on the beach path.
Girl: I just saw a funny balloon fly over. It looked like a Meowth. So cute!
Girl: I heard Team Rocket tried to settle here on Ascorbia. What could they want?
Man: I often walk in Ascorbia Forest. Lately there are more shady types about than usual.
Man: I often walk in Ascorbia Forest. It's so peaceful, you forget all your troubles.
Wartortle: Tortle!
Wartortle: Wartor!
Wartortle: Tor tortle!
Wartortle: Wartortle!
Wartortle: Tortle tortle!
Kid: Boing! We're having a Body Slam contest. You'd be squashed flat! I'll teach one of your Pokémon instead.
done: Kid: Boing! Boing!

lines: Woman: Team Wartortle kidnapped?! What do I do if my house catches fire?
Woman: With Team Wartortle always on call, I feel safe on Ascorbia.
Aidan: There you are! We had to rush straight back, so I never thanked you properly. Thank you!
Aidan: Take this. TM Flamethrower: I use it to train Team Wartortle. I hope it helps you!
